questions.prompt: What, according to the text, is Jerrowsett’s reason for going past her meter’s curve in the top octave?

options.text: Her meter took its dozen notes from the middle of the keyboard, and its curve stops where they stop.
A small instrument loses more to the stiffness of its wire than the figure allows for.
The cold hall will take the piano flat again, and the extra cents are put in against that.
The last notes come in over a hand playing two octaves lower, and have to match it.
